body:
Other issues I spotted:
- The suffix is also ignored for minimum size. It can overlap arrows and go out of bounds.
- Changing `label` does not update minimum size immediately.

However they can be fixed in a separate PR, as they don't cause problems in the inspector.

The code could use a check from someone more familiar with text drawing.

It is still overlapping for the long numbers. --- `shaped_text_draw` clip arguments are relative to the drawn string (do not account for position it is drawn at), not to the canvas it is drawn on, so feeding same values to different strings drawn at different offset is clearly wrong. I have not checked clipping value calculations. --- Not sure if clipping numbers is a good idea in general, clipped number does not carry any useful information, and it is not visually clear when it is clipped. Instead, I would make it show only one of the following: - Full number + suffix if it fits. - Full number w/o suffix if it fits. - Number in scientific notation (`99e99`) (with or w/o suffix), if it is shorter and fits. - `…` if neither of above fits. Or at least generic ellipsis clipping to show when it's cut (but it does not work well with short strings).
